interactive.label: trajectory_1
interactive.tooltip: The first trajectory: its frames come first (time) or its atoms first (atoms).

interactive.label: trajectory_2
interactive.tooltip: The second trajectory: appended after the first (time) or beside it (atoms).

interactive.label: topology
interactive.tooltip: The structure that names the atoms of both trajectories; a DCD stores coordinates only.
Open the PDB that names the atoms. DCD stores coordinates only, so this is required for them.

interactive.label: 💾 Save joined…
interactive.tooltip: Join the two trajectories and write the result as a new DCD trajectory.

interactive.label: By time (append frames)
interactive.tooltip: By time joins the trajectories along the frame axis (same topology, frames appended). By atoms stacks the trajectories along the atom axis (same number of frames, topologies merged).

interactive.label: By atoms (stack)
interactive.tooltip: By time joins the trajectories along the frame axis (same topology, frames appended). By atoms stacks the trajectories along the atom axis (same number of frames, topologies merged).

interactive.label: Reverse trajectory 1
interactive.tooltip: Reverse trajectory 1 in time (last frame first) before joining.

interactive.label: Reverse trajectory 2
interactive.tooltip: Reverse trajectory 2 in time (last frame first) before joining.

interactive.label: chunk_size
interactive.tooltip: Frames written per block. The inputs are read whole; the block bounds the copy the join makes.
